$comment: /join/ — the account's start page, where every Join The Labs button leads (GOV.UK's start-page pattern: just enough to know what you're starting, one button, what happens next). The button goes to the live site's sign-in with ?path= carried over from the link that brought you (proposed for OLOS to route you after sign-in). Words for each path are keyed by its slug.

meta.need: As someone ready to join, I need to know what the free account gets me and what happens next, so that I start without hesitating.

title: Join The Labs
description: One free account, and every path starts from it: workshops, a Build Cycle, a place to help. It takes a minute, and you sign in with Google.

hero.title: One free account. Every path starts here.
hero.lede: It takes a minute. Then you'll see what's on near you, and the people who are already in.

items.title: What's on near you
items.body: Every workshop and event at the Lab near you, and a seat at any of them.

items.title: The people
items.body: The community's channels, and a profile the people you build with can see.

items.title: A Build Cycle
items.body: Applying for the next cycle happens from your account, when applications open.

items.title: A place to help
items.body: Lead a workshop, mentor a team, improve the guides. It starts here too.

start.note: We use only your name, email address and profile picture, and never ask for your Gmail, Drive or Calendar.

steps.title: Sign in with Google
steps.body: No form, no password. Your name and photo come with you.

steps.title: Find the Lab near you
steps.body: Tell us where you are. If there's a Lab near you, you'll see what's on. If not, you'll hear the moment one opens.

steps.title: Pick your first thing
steps.body: A workshop this week, the next Build Cycle, or a way to help. Most people end up doing all three.

paths.$comment: Shown under the title when the link that brought you carried a path (?path=). Each says what the account leads to for that path.
paths.build: Your account, then apply for the next Build Cycle.
paths.contribute: Your account, then a place to help.
paths.start-a-lab: Your account, then tell us where you are. We'll talk it through with you.
paths.upskiller: Your account, then apply for the next Build Cycle.
paths.mentor: Your account, then help at a workshop.
paths.poderator: Your account, then a Build Cycle, where Poderators are asked.
paths.ambassador: Your account, then orientation, and the button in person.
paths.problem: Your account, then tell us about the problem.

fine: Free, and it stays free. The Labs is made by volunteers and open to anyone.
